authority: PI, 2026-09-04, before Rung 0 is built or run: the parent spec's Rung-0 failure reading is too strong and must be split three ways.
rule: APPEND, not an edit. No seed, gate, recipe or ordering changes. Only the permitted inference from a Rung-0 non-pass is corrected.

THE_OVERSTATEMENT.parent_spec_said: a Rung-0 FAIL means 'the latent-dispatch/eval path cannot express crossover even with the frozen specialists installed verbatim... everything downstream would need re-examination'
THE_OVERSTATEMENT.why_that_is_too_strong: the gate requires delta > 0 AND LCB95 > 0 on BOTH poles at n=64 seeds per cell. A dispatch wrapper that is mechanically exact can still produce positive point estimates with one confidence interval crossing zero on a fresh block -- that is a POWER and seed-stability outcome, not evidence that the instrument cannot express crossover. Conflating the two would let ordinary sampling noise be read as an instrumentation catastrophe.
THE_OVERSTATEMENT.note_on_the_ceiling: even the specialist baseline itself passed with delta_A LCB95 at +0.0156 (SPECIALIST_BASELINE_EVAL_RESULT.json) -- a narrow margin. A fresh 64-seed block reproducing the same policies could plausibly land just under it.

CORRECTED_THREE_WAY_READING.reading: positive control succeeds; the dispatch path and gate can express crossover. Proceed to Rung 1.

CORRECTED_THREE_WAY_READING.outcome: both deltas > 0 but one or both CIs cross zero
CORRECTED_THREE_WAY_READING.reading: a POWER / seed-stability outcome, not an instrument failure. The direction is right and the magnitude is consistent with the specialists; the block simply did not resolve it at n=64. Investigate statistical stability and fresh-block sensitivity BEFORE attributing anything to architecture or instrumentation.
CORRECTED_THREE_WAY_READING.action: investigate power; do NOT declare the instrument broken; do NOT proceed to Rung 1 until the stability question is settled, since every later rung inherits the same n

CORRECTED_THREE_WAY_READING.outcome: tie or reversal on either pole, OR any behavioural mismatch from the frozen specialists
CORRECTED_THREE_WAY_READING.reading: the wrapper or evaluator is at fault. A mechanically exact dispatch of pi_A and pi_B cannot reverse the specialists' own direction. STOP the ladder and audit immediately.

argmax actions identical on every checked state and every head

MANDATORY_EQUIVALENCE_PREFLIGHT_BEFORE_T.on_any_failure: the seal does NOT open. A wrapper that is not bit-exact is not a positive control.

WHAT_RUNG_0_ASKS_ONCE_THE_PREFLIGHT_PASS: Can the exact two successful policies survive simply being dispatched through z? Nothing about compression is being tested at this rung -- only whether the dispatch-and-evaluate path preserves what the specialists already demonstrated.
